data.name: lblPage5Text.Text
data.value:
For all other attacks, the attackers can only play a card that matches a value already on the table.
If an attacker has no cards to play, they must end their turn, passing to the next attacker.

data.name: lblPage8Text.Text
data.value:
If the defender can’t or chooses not to play a card and ends their turn, they lose the defence.
The attackers are allowed to give the defender whatever cards they could have played, and the defender takes all cards on the table.

data.name: lblPage11Text.Text
data.value:
When a player runs out of cards when the deck is empty, they win, but the game isn’t over until all but one player runs out of cards.
That final player is the loser of the game, the ‘Durak’ or the fool.

data.name: lblPage12Text.Text
data.value:
If the Trade Trump setting is enabled, on their turn, a player can click the trump card in the corner.
If they have the 6 of trump in their hand, it will switch the 6 of trump with the deck trump card.

data.name: lblPage13Text.Text
data.value:
If the Trade Trump setting is ace only, on their turn, a player can click the trump card in the corner.
If they have the 6 of trump in their hand, it won’t switch unless the deck trump card is the ace of trump.
